findings.title: Exposed Credential: Stripe API Key
findings.description: Hardcoded live Stripe secret API key detected in repository files.
findings.remediation: Revoke the exposed key in the Stripe Dashboard immediately and migrate to an environment variable store.

findings.title: Wildcard Dependency Version: express
findings.description: Dependency 'express' specifies wildcard version '*'. Wildcard dependencies introduce breaking changes into production deployments.
findings.remediation: Pin the dependency to an exact semantic version (e.g. ^4.19.2).

findings.title: Unpinned Docker Base Image
findings.description: The Dockerfile FROM statement uses an unpinned or ':latest' image tag.
findings.remediation: Pin the base image to a specific version or SHA digest (e.g., node:20-alpine).
